annotations.title: Get a Good Day, This Week edition

description: One Good Day, This Week edition in full and in structure, by its number (such as "036" or "36"), or the newest when no number is given. Use for the week's stories with their sources, the tracked weekly items (WAPA, government, federal, infrastructure), By the Numbers and Also This Week. Good Day is an automated news digest and analysis, operated by Brian Louden, and each edition says so in its byline.

edition.description: Edition number, such as "036" or 36, or the edition URL. Default: the newest edition.
